reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: getMember is actively called from memberStatus.ts, nickname.ts, rolesSync.ts, roles.ts, and rolesSyncAll.ts — not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; Discord API is an external service with no defined trust level. Gate 3: src/utils/discord.ts is explicitly in-scope. Spec deviation is confirmed (catch block collapses NOT_FOUND and API_ERROR into a single null return), but exploitability depends on Discord API transient failure or rate-limiting — an external condition not directly attacker-controlled — so attack path is uncertain.
